game_start.intro: O le a amata le taalafou. Trump suit: {trump_suit} (trump kaata: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
E te tagata taalo {player_id} i German Whist.
{phase_info}
E te maua {hand_size} pepe.
Taalo se pepe ma '[play N]', i le faaiuga o lona nofoaga i totonu o lou lima (mo se faatauga '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: FAASAGA AʻOAʻI: o le tagata manumalo i togafiti taitasi e ave ai pepa ua faasaga a'e ma o lē na toilalo, e toso mai le isi kata mai le pusa. O togafiti sa maua i lenei vaega e leai se aogā mo le manumalo.
player_prompt.phase_playing: PLAYING PHASE: the deck is exhausted. Every trick from now on counts towards victory.

next_card.playing_phase: E leai se pepa e ofo atu - ua amata le vaega o taʻaloga.
next_card.deck_empty: Ua leai se isi kata o loo iai i le pusa.
next_card.available: O le kata o loo ofoina atu: {card}
next_card.available_trump: O le pepa o loo ofoina atu: {card} (TRUMP)

invalid_move.wrong_format: Faʻaaoga le '[play N]' e taina ai le pepa Nth i lou lima.
invalid_move.bad_position: E lē o iai lenā tulaga. O loo iā te oe {hand_size} pepa.
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: E tatau ona e mulimuli i le faaaʻoaʻoga ma taaalo ai se pepa {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: E lē mafai ona taʻalo lenā kata.

game_action.played: O le tagata taalo {player_id} na taaalo i le {card}.

trick.won: O le tagata taalo {winner_id} e manumalo i le togafiti ma {card}.
trick.won_learning: Tagata taalo {winner_id} manumalo le kaata ma {card} ma maua le kaata e faasolo

phase.learning_complete: Ua uma le vaega o aʻoaʻoga - e tāua foʻi togafiti taʻitasi ua totoe mo lo tatou manumalo.

draw.winner_preview: O le isi pepa o loo ofoina atu, e {card}.
